verdict.rationale: Jira's feature page says Rovo AI, built into the product, can 'identify trends to surface new opportunities and remove bottle necks' from work data. It also says Rovo AI can break down ideas into tasks and suggest assignees, which covers both insights and suggestions inside the product. The support is only short marketing one-liners with no in-depth documentation or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: detailed docs on what insights are generated and from which data, how users view or act on them in the UI, plan or availability limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Use Rovo AI to identify trends to surface new opportunities and remove bottle necks.
Breakdown big ideas into actionable tasks and automatically assign them to the right person with Rovo AI.
Rovo AI connects relevant assets and rich data from Confluence, Figma, and your 3rd party apps to your work.
